note.en: The current package falls back to the alt text as the caption, while the reference emits no `<figcaption>` for `figcaption: "title"`.
note.zh: 当前包回退使用 alt 文本作为 caption，而参考包在 `figcaption: "title"` 下不输出 `<figcaption>`。

note.en: The current package falls back to the alt text as the caption, while the reference emits no `<figcaption>` for `figcaption: "title"`.
note.zh: 当前包回退使用 alt 文本作为 caption，而参考包在 `figcaption: "title"` 下不输出 `<figcaption>`。

note.en: The current package skips images inside hidden (tight list) paragraphs, so the paragraph is untouched; the reference converts it and emits a `<figcaption>` without a `<figure>` wrapper.
note.zh: 当前包会跳过隐藏（紧凑列表）段落中的图片，因此该段落保持原样；参考包会进行转换，并输出不带 `<figure>` 包裹的 `<figcaption>`。

notes.en: `focusable` is disabled because the current package adds `tabindex="0"` to the image, while the reference `tabindex` option numbers figures from `1`; the reference option is therefore not used.
notes.zh: `focusable` 设为 `false`，因为当前包会给图片添加 `tabindex="0"`，而参考包的 `tabindex` 选项从 `1` 开始为 figure 编号；因此不使用参考包的该选项。

notes.en: The current package derives `<figcaption>` from the image `title` and falls back to the `alt` text; `markdown-it-image-figures` has no fallback mode, so `figcaption: "title"` is compared and alt-only images are documented as a difference.
notes.zh: 当前包从图片 `title` 生成 `<figcaption>`，并回退到 `alt` 文本；`markdown-it-image-figures` 没有回退模式，因此只对比 `figcaption: "title"`，仅有 alt 的图片被记录为差异。

notes.en: The current package skips hidden paragraphs (tight list items) so that a `<figcaption>` is never emitted without its `<figure>` wrapper; the reference converts images in tight list items without a `<figure>` wrapper. Documented in `tight-list-image`.
notes.zh: 当前包会跳过隐藏段落（紧凑列表项），从而绝不在没有 `<figure>` 包裹的情况下输出 `<figcaption>`；参考包会转换紧凑列表项中的图片，但不生成 `<figure>` 包裹。已在 `tight-list-image` 中记录。

notes.en: `moveAttrs` is not compared: for `true` the current package copies non-native image attributes to `<figure>` and keeps them on the image, for a pattern list it moves them (the image loses them), and it merges `class`/`style` values. The reference `copyAttrs` copies every matching attribute to `<figure>` and keeps the original order on the image, which is not equivalent.
notes.zh: 不对比 `moveAttrs`：取 `true` 时当前包将非原生图片属性复制到 `<figure>` 并保留在图片上，取模式列表时则移动这些属性（图片不再保留），并合并 `class`/`style` 值。参考包的 `copyAttrs` 会把每个匹配属性复制到 `<figure>`，并在图片上保留原始顺序，两者并不等价。

notes.en: Reference-only options (`dataType`, `link`, `tabindex`, `lazy`, `async`, `classes`, `removeSrc`) have no equivalent and are not compared.
notes.zh: 仅参考包支持的选项（`dataType`、`link`、`tabindex`、`lazy`、`async`、`classes`、`removeSrc`）没有对应实现，因此不参与对比。

notes.en: Scaling: the reference core rule walks the token stream once and calls `md.parseInline` once per caption, so the work is linear in the document size and caption length; all three series measure ~1 (no superlinear behavior was found in the upstream implementation).
notes.zh: 扩展性：参考包的核心规则只遍历一次 token 流，并为每个 caption 调用一次 `md.parseInline`，因此工作量与文档大小和 caption 长度成线性关系；三个序列的拟合指数均约为 1（上游实现中未发现超线性行为）。
